headword: {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}

definitions.explanation: A Japanese banknote with a face value of 10,000 yen. The highest denomination of Japanese paper currency and the most commonly used bill for large purchases.

examples.japanese: {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧んです⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I only have a ten-thousand-yen bill.

examples.japanese: すみません、{一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}せます→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Excuse me, can you break a ten-thousand-yen bill?

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{渋沢栄一|しぶさわえいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{肖像|しょうぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}かれている→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The new ten-thousand-yen bill depicts a portrait of Shibusawa Eiichi.

notes:
The {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ} is the highest denomination of Japanese currency. Colloquially called {万札|まんさつ}. As of 2024, the bill features {渋沢栄一|しぶさわえいいち}, known as the father of Japanese capitalism. The previous design (1984-2024) featured {福沢諭吉|ふくざわゆきち}, the founder of Keio University, and was informally called a {諭吉|ゆきち}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧: to break a 10,000-yen bill
- {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay with a 10,000-yen bill
- {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to take out a 10,000-yen bill

USAGE:
At small shops, convenience stores (⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧), and vending machines, using a {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ} for small purchases may be inconvenient due to the large amount of change required. Some vending machines and small establishments do not accept {一万円札|いちまんえんさつ}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {万札|まんさつ}: 10,000-yen bill — informal abbreviation
- ⟦{千円札|せんえんさつ}→千円札：16603_senensatsu⟧: 1,000-yen bill
- ⟦{五千円札|ごせんえんさつ}→五千円札：26561_gosenensatsu⟧: 5,000-yen bill
